name: Enthrall

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Chosen seen creatures make WIS saves; fighting caster/allies automatically succeeds; source-bound minus 10 to Perception and Passive Perception for Concentration duration.

rules.text: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range to make a Wisdom saving throw.
Any creature you or your companions are fighting automatically succeeds on this save.
On a failed save, a target has a −10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception until the spell ends.
